verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents payment plans for setting up customer subscriptions and recurring payments via payment links, so the recurring-billing and plans parts of the story are covered, though only by brief mentions. Nothing in the pack shows trials, plan upgrades or downgrades, or proration. Missing for 10: free trial periods, plan upgrade/downgrade flows, proration logic, in-depth API docs for subscription lifecycle management, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration

citations.quote: Payment plans let you set up subscriptions for your customers on Flutterwave.
Receive one-off or recurring payments from anyone, anywhere, via your unique payment link.
